palette.strategy: restrained; acid reserved for selection, checked chip and mark rule

type.note: serif carries headings, document text, paper columns and cards; mono only for offsets and scores; smallest functional font 0.75rem, visual micro-labels floor 0.8rem

layout.desktop: two-column desk: source 3fr, analysis board 2fr; comparison two ruled papers; deck below
layout.mobile: single column below 920px, controls wrap, no sideways scroll

signature.mark: stroke-based lens with a petrol check and a single acid rule, svg symbol lens-mark
signature.materials: ruled paper via repeating-linear-gradient at line-height, petrol margin rule, hairline ink separators
signature.chrome: acid selection, petrol caret, thin petrol scrollbars, petrol focus ring

motion.banned: smooth scrolling, animated transitions on state

invariants: no hero, no kicker or helper line under the title
no emojis, no long dashes in copy
no innerHTML; fixed tags with textContent only
no external requests, fonts or storage; everything in-tab
all controls are native elements at least 24px tall
